title: Private Pass
tagline: A stupidly easy way to verify your identity, to comply with regulations, without sacrificing your privacy.

prizes.placement: 🆔 Polygon — 🥈 Best use of Polygon ID
prizes.title: Polygon

description: Private Pass allows users to easily verify government credentials and issue them as verifiable credentials to meet requirements for websites or services. It uses Dock.io as a issuer and Polygon ID as a means to store credentials and generate cryptographic proofs. This combines existing services and makes it easy for the end user to store credentials that have been verified through a KYC service.
how_its_made:
This project uses Dock.io with Polygon ID where Dock.io is the issuer of credentials and Polygon ID is both the technology and app that stores and creates cryptographic proofs to verify information about themselves.

For the technology, I'm using a turbo monorepo stack with trpc, nextjs, vitejs, prisma, and more. Trpc for better typings across multiple endpoints, NextJS for the marketing of the website, vitesjs for the user dashboard, and Prisma to keep track of passes issued.
